CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, June 19, 2024 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Laura Longoria, Commission Member
  Danielle Massaro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE MAY 15, 2024 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  June 19, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, May 15, 2024
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:04 P.M. on Wednesday, May 15, 2024, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano, Commission Member Longoria and Commission Member Massaro.
Commission Members Absent: None.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR THE 2024-2025 TERM
Election of President Canseco and Vice President Susan Saunders.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE APRIL 17, 2024 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
With a motion from President Canseco and a second from Vice President Saunders the April 17,
2024 minutes were approved.

ALHAMBRA DISTRICT ART PROJECTS
Commission Member Hermano is working with a muralist on creating a digital rendering that
will incorporate archived photographs from the Alhambra Historical Society Museum. Director
Macias agreed to locate city owned utility boxes for Commission Member Longoria. The
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission will continue their art project research and
return to the next meeting to discuss.

STAFF REPORT
Tiffany Chew, Economic Development Specialist, presented a utility box rendering proposed by
the Downtown Alhambra Business Association, Nucleus Gallery and Community Development
Department. The utility box’s location will be on the southwest corner of Main Street and First
Street with the funding and design subject to approval from the Alhambra City Council. The
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission provided positive input to Ms. Chew,
applauding the dragon design, composition, and inviting message “Come Explore Alhambra”.
President Canseco proposed the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meet with
the Downtown Alhambra Business Association to discuss future public art project collaborations.

Rick Abe, AIA architect, exhibited a PowerPoint for the proposed “Legacy of The Alhambra”
public art project at Monterey Bay Square, 100-120 Monterey Road, Alhambra, CA 91801. Mr.
 Abe’s team will fabricate a stainless steel frieze, referencing pattern designs from the “The
Alhambra” in Spain, backlit with LED to the top of the parking structure. A plaque explaining
the inspiration and connection to “The Alhambra” in Spain will be displayed on site. With a
motion from President Canseco and a second from Vice President Saunders, the “Legacy of the
Alhambra” design was approved by the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to move
forward to the Alhambra Planning Commission for review.

With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Commissioner Longoria, the Alhambra
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission approved the 2025 Tournament of Roses Parade
Alhambra float rendering titled “Good Day Dreamin’” with minor adjustments.

Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard shared event details and invited the Alhambra City Arts
and Cultural Events Commission to the 626 Mission to Mission event on April 28th and
Memorial Day Celebration on May 27th.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
Jennifer Kuo, Public Health Professional and Health and Wellness Facilitator, shared her goal to
improve health and wellbeing in communities through arts participation as a health behavior. Ms.
Kuo provided data, research, and a pilot proposal that is currently under review with Los
Angeles County and invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to connect
with future initiatives.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
None.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the May 15, 2024
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 8:10 P.M.
